Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::modifyLoanTerm(itemid: Integer,content: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanTerm: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemId),
		updated: Boolean = if loanTerm.oclIsUndefined() 
		then false 
		else (loanTerm.Content = content) 
		endif 
	precondition:
		loanTerm.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		loanTerm.Content = content and
		result = updated
}
